def transform(grid):
    """Keep cells where the upper and lower patterns overlap; recolor to 2."""
    separator = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if row and all(value == row[0] for value in row) and row[0] != 0)
    upper = grid[:separator]
    lower = grid[separator + 1:]
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] and lower[r][c] else 0
             for c in range(len(lower[r]))]
            for r in range(len(lower))]
